svg.title: Unlimited over six channels
svg.desc: Spectrograms of the hf transmission of Hi after clean, USB shifted, LSB inverted, AM, FM and CCIR poor channels, each with the real decoder's result and its success rate over 20 seeds.
svg.text: The hf transmission “Hi” through six simulated channels
sim::Channel output (300–2700 Hz, 1.4 s each), decoded by the real Decoder with the profile shown.
The receiver is told only its profile. Last line of each tile: 20 runs of that channel with other noise and fading seeds.
locked: 1500 Hz, T 16.0 ms, N 8; SNR 86.0 dB
locked: 1650 Hz, T 16.0 ms, N 8; SNR 9.7 dB
locked: 1350 Hz, T 16.0 ms, N 8; SNR 10.4 dB
locked: 1500 Hz, T 16.0 ms, N 8; SNR 4.9 dB
locked: 1500 Hz, T 16.0 ms, N 8; SNR 22.3 dB
no lock in this run: nothing released
SNR: key-down tone power over noise in 2500 Hz (AM: carrier power; FM: CNR in 12.5 kHz). LSB inverts the audio: the twist survives it.
The SNR in each tile is the Decoder's own estimate. Missing bytes are never replaced by guesses (spec 3.13).
